# src/forge

`createPullRequest` within `src/forge` abstracts pull request creation across Git forges using platform-specific CLI tools. `createPullRequest` acts as the unified entry point, delegating to `createGitHubPR`, `createGitLabMR`, or `createBitbucketPR` based on the `ForgeType` argument.

## Contents

- [github.ts](./github.ts) — Implements `createPullRequest` delegation logic and platform-specific CLI invocations.

## API Surface

- `createPullRequest(branch, title, body?, forge?, cwd?)` — Delegates to platform-specific PR creation, returns CLI stdout.
- `ForgeType` — Union `"github" | "gitlab" | "bitbucket"` defining supported platforms.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `createGitHubPR` invokes `gh pr create` with `--head`, `--base`, `--title`, `--body` args.
- `createGitLabMR` invokes `glab mr create` with `--source-branch`, `--target-branch`, `--title`, `--description` args.
- `createBitbucketPR` invokes `bb pr create` with `--source`, `--dest`, `--title`, `--body` args.
- `createGitHubPR` throws `GitHub CLI failed: ${stderr}` if `result.exitCode !== 0`.
- `createGitLabMR` throws `GitLab CLI failed: ${stderr}` on failure.
- `createBitbucketPR` throws generic `Bitbucket PR creation failed` message.

## File Relationships

- `spawnSync` from `bun` executes CLI commands synchronously within `github.ts`.
- `getDefaultBranch`, `getRepoRoot` from `../git.ts` resolve repository context for PR targets.
